text: No significant tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020. Earth-observation data from 2021 to 2025 (the latest available) show no detected loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger. The asset had 43.3 hectares of forest cover in 2020, and annual monitoring at 30-meter resolution confirmed no stand-replacing losses during the period. However, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or losses along edges might not be captured. The evidence does not confirm absolute zero change but indicates no major deforestation post-2020.
